title: Human reaction-time prediction
why_ahead: ACT-R treats latency as part of the cognitive theory and fits model behavior to human timing.
aura_comparison: Aura has runtime/token latency telemetry but no validated cognitive latency theory.
build: Build a human-behavior calibration harness for memory, choice, interruption and skill tasks; fit only identifiable parameters.
proof: Held-out human latency and error distributions are predicted better than simple baselines.

title: Activation-driven retrieval latency
why_ahead: ACT-R retrieval latency is mechanistically tied to activation.
aura_comparison: Aura actr_activation.py explicitly found ACT-R latency does not transfer to ranked-scan recall (r^2 about 0.000037).
build: Either redesign retrieval as an activation-driven race or build an Aura-native latency law based on actual retrieval work.
proof: Intervening on activation must change latency in the predicted direction after controlling candidate count/backend.

title: Canonical buffer/module semantics
why_ahead: ACT-R modules communicate through standardized buffers with well-defined visibility and requests.
aura_comparison: Aura uses many service interfaces, event buses, dataclasses and bridges but no universal cognitive-port contract.
build: Introduce CognitivePort with content, provenance, confidence, state version, operation request and causal receipt.
proof: Most cross-organ handoffs use the contract and lesions yield selective predictable deficits.

title: Production compilation
why_ahead: ACT-R compiles multi-step procedures into faster direct productions as skill develops.
aura_comparison: Aura has chunks, habits, action composition and RLC, but no universal trace-to-procedure compiler.
build: Create TraceCompiler over successful causal traces, preserving preconditions, effects and governance.
proof: Repeated tasks become faster/cheaper; lesion compiled procedures restores novice cost.

title: Production utility learning
why_ahead: Compiled productions gain learned utility and compete with old rules.
aura_comparison: Aura chunk EV and rule confidence are local mechanisms rather than one common procedural value system.
build: Standardize ProceduralValue: payoff, time saved, match cost, risk, confidence, recency and transfer value.
proof: Procedures from different learners compete under one value contract and demote when value turns negative.

title: Validated partial matching/interference
why_ahead: ACT-R partial matching is used to explain graded retrieval errors and interference.
aura_comparison: Aura has semantic similarity and mismatch penalties but no unified human-validated error theory.
build: Model commission vs omission errors and cue interference using live Aura recalls plus human memory datasets.
proof: Predict which wrong memory/error type occurs before answer observation.

title: Perceptual/motor timing model
why_ahead: ACT-R perceptual and motor modules make quantitative timing predictions for interaction.
aura_comparison: Aura screen_pursuit uses engineering waits/focus/stabilization, not human cognitive timing laws.
build: Instrument perception selection encoding motor execution and verification stages; compare against HCI datasets.
proof: Out-of-sample task-time distributions match data across interface complexity levels.

title: Individual-difference modeling
why_ahead: ACT-R research often models stable cognitive differences by identifiable parameters.
aura_comparison: Aura has many tunables but no trait/state/implementation parameter taxonomy.
build: Create longitudinal trait estimation and parameter-recovery tests.
proof: Stable trait estimates recur across sessions while state variables vary with context.

title: Neurocognitive triangulation
why_ahead: ACT-R has extensive work connecting architecture timing/modules to neural measurements.
aura_comparison: Aura neuroscience mappings are mostly analogical and pluralistic.
build: Require biological-variable -> computational-variable -> predicted signature -> falsifier metadata.
proof: At least one subsystem predicts multiple neural/behavioral signatures without per-task refitting.

title: Repository-wide parameter provenance
why_ahead: ACT-R culture emphasizes fit parameters and model-data comparison.
aura_comparison: Aura actr_activation.py records provenance and rejects a bad latency fit, but many cognitive constants remain heuristic.
build: Create ParameterRegistry with source, fitted/policy status, dataset hash, uncertainty and sensitivity.
proof: CI blocks claims of calibration without reproducible fit metadata.

title: Event-level cognitive tracing
why_ahead: ACT-R event simulation yields clear stepwise traces.
aura_comparison: Aura has receipts/logs/workspace history but no one complete causal timeline.
build: Create monotonic CognitiveEvent IDs spanning perception, retrieval, workspace, self-state, planning, action and learning.
proof: A consequential action can be reconstructed as a complete causal DAG from one trace bundle.

title: Cumulative external task corpus
why_ahead: ACT-R has decades of published models across memory, HCI, language, skill and decision tasks.
aura_comparison: Aura has huge internal tests but far less external cognitive-model replication.
build: Port canonical paradigms and compare Aura, ACT-R and human curves.
proof: Frozen public battery is independently reproducible.

title: Mechanistic parsimony
why_ahead: ACT-R explains broad cognition with a comparatively compact set of mechanisms.
aura_comparison: Aura has many specialized organs and duplicated control motifs.
build: Launch architecture compression: merge mechanisms with the same computational invariant.
proof: Module count/dependency complexity decreases without losing causal benchmark signatures.

title: Validated forgetting/spacing laws
why_ahead: ACT-R base-level activation has extensive evidence for power-law practice/forgetting behavior.
aura_comparison: Aura implements the form but has not established its own long-horizon spacing/forgetting curves.
build: Run controlled longitudinal rehearsal schedules across Aura memory types.
proof: Held-out retention curves beat recency-only/exponential baselines.

title: Resource-rational cognitive stopping
why_ahead: Modern ACT-R work treats cognition as resource-rational, not just correct.
aura_comparison: Aura budgets compute operationally but does not have a universal cognitive value-of-compute theory.
build: Learn when to search, retrieve, compile, ask or stop from expected gain minus cognitive cost.
proof: Adaptive policy solves more tasks at matched compute than fixed budgets.

title: Automatic substate creation
why_ahead: Soar architecture automatically creates a substate whenever its decision procedure reaches an impasse.
aura_comparison: Aura core/cognition/impasse.py classifies ties/conflicts/rejection/no-change but does not universally instantiate a subordinate problem-solving state.
build: Create CognitiveSubstate with inherited context, local goal, budget, parent causal ID and result channel.
proof: Induced impasses across planning/memory/tool selection/representation search all enter the same recursive mechanism.

title: Architecture-wide recursive subgoaling
why_ahead: Soar can encounter impasses inside substates, yielding uniform recursive problem solving.
aura_comparison: Aura recursion exists in multiple subsystem-specific forms.
build: Make substate nesting generic with cycle/budget bounds.
proof: Three unrelated domains generate nested subgoals without new recursion code.

title: Dependency backtracing
why_ahead: Soar chunking backtraces exactly which state facts and productions supported the resolving result.
aura_comparison: Aura procedural_generalization uses invariants/lesions/counterexamples, but not a complete architecture-wide causal dependency trace.
build: Record every fact/operator dependency consumed in a substate and compile transitive supports only.
proof: Chunk fires under paraphrase when causal supports match and fails when a support is counterfactually removed.

title: Generalized chunk semantics
why_ahead: Soar chunks create working-memory results/preferences that directly resolve future decisions.
aura_comparison: Aura exact chunks store resolution labels and generalized rules propose actions outside a universal decision language.
build: Make learned outputs typed assertions/preferences/operators rather than opaque strings.
proof: Future impasse resolves from learned chunk without original solver invocation.

title: Rich preference algebra
why_ahead: Soar has explicit better/worse, require/prohibit, reject, acceptable and indifferent preference semantics.
aura_comparison: Aura combines scalar scores, Will/governance gates and subsystem-specific constraints.
build: Create typed cognitive Preference distinct from authority.
proof: Tie/conflict/constraint failures emerge from algebra rather than special cases.

title: Incremental production matching
why_ahead: Soar uses mature production matching optimized for large rule sets.
aura_comparison: Aura Python rule stores/MeTTa patterns may scale poorly with lifetime learning.
build: Benchmark Rete/discrimination-network indexing for promoted procedures.
proof: 10x rule growth yields much less than 10x decision matching cost.

title: Chunk explanation tooling
why_ahead: Soar EBC contains mature trace structures for why chunks were generated.
aura_comparison: Aura has receipts and causal evidence but no single chunk debugger.
build: Persist origin impasse, dependency DAG, rejected conditions, counterexamples, utility and future firings.
proof: Any procedure can produce a minimal reproducible explanation of why it exists.

title: Negative-condition handling
why_ahead: Soar explicitly treats overgeneralization caused by negative/absence reasoning.
aura_comparison: Aura contradiction/lesion checks do not universally distinguish observed-negative from unobserved/inaccessible.
build: Make epistemic status of absence first-class in compiled traces.
proof: Hidden/missing observations cannot become causal negative preconditions.

title: RL integrated with preference selection
why_ahead: Soar reinforcement learning updates numeric preferences in the same operator framework.
aura_comparison: Aura habits/RL/value systems are distributed.
build: Attach learned value to the common Preference representation.
proof: Symbolic and learned preferences combine transparently and lesions are interpretable.

title: One state/operator problem-solving skeleton
why_ahead: Soar uses the same state/operator cycle across domains.
aura_comparison: Aura has several overlapping executive loops.
build: Define canonical perceive/update -> propose -> prefer -> select -> apply -> verify -> learn cycle.
proof: At least five current loops become configurations of the same kernel.

title: Lifetime procedural scaling
why_ahead: Soar has decades of experience with chunk utility and production growth.
aura_comparison: Aura caps stores but has no million-decision/lifetime procedural ecology proof.
build: Run accelerated lifetime simulations with distribution shift and millions of rule firings.
proof: Latency/memory stay bounded while useful old procedures survive.

title: Unified cognitive debugger
why_ahead: Soar exposes mature traces over states/operators/preferences/productions.
aura_comparison: Aura debugging is powerful but scattered.
build: Build one Cognitive Debugger combining event DAG, workspace, self-state, goals, memories, rules and receipts.
proof: Root cause a complex failed action without multi-log manual grep.

title: Operator abstraction consistency
why_ahead: Soar operators are a domain-portable state transformation abstraction.
aura_comparison: Aura tools, skills, Doing ASTs, planner actions and RLC opcodes differ.
build: Define Operator(preconditions,effects,cost,risk,reversibility,observability,binding).
proof: Same learner/planner consumes GUI, file, puzzle and social operators.

title: Automatic learning occasion
why_ahead: Impasse resolution is intrinsically an occasion for learning in Soar.
aura_comparison: Aura learners still require path-specific calls.
build: Make impasse resolution/repeated successful trace/prediction correction architecture-level learning events.
proof: New decision domains produce learning records without author wiring.

title: Core-architecture minimality
why_ahead: Soar deliberately seeks broad behavior from a small fixed kernel plus learned knowledge.
aura_comparison: Aura has architecture saturation.
build: Treat new modules as last resort; first test whether the function is an instance of existing primitives.
proof: New releases reduce or hold cognitive kernel complexity while capability grows.

title: Non-axiomatic epistemic contract
why_ahead: NARS assumes all knowledge is experience-derived, revisable and resource-conditioned.
aura_comparison: Aura uncertainty/provenance are strong but vary across subsystems.
build: Make every belief source-bound, revisable, evidence-bearing and time/resource conditioned.
proof: Belief-producing APIs cannot omit provenance/evidence semantics.

title: Evidence-independence stamps
why_ahead: NARS tracks evidential history to avoid treating the same evidence as independent confirmation.
aura_comparison: Aura receipts/hashes do not universally prevent confidence double counting across derivations.
build: Add EvidenceSet lineage and overlap-aware fusion.
proof: Duplicate derivations do not increase confidence; independent observations do.

title: Frequency/confidence truth values everywhere
why_ahead: NARS separates support frequency from confidence/evidence amount across reasoning.
aura_comparison: Aura AtomSpace has analogous strength/count semantics, but other belief stores differ.
build: Standardize EvidenceTruth adapters across memory, planner, world/social models and AtomSpace.
proof: Cross-store beliefs retain calibrated uncertainty after conversion.

title: Priority-durability-quality budgets
why_ahead: Every NARS task/concept/link has budget dimensions controlling processing and decay.
aura_comparison: Aura has many priority/importance/deadline systems but no universal CognitiveBudget.
build: Introduce common priority,durability,quality,expected_cost,deadline fields.
proof: Mind-wide scheduler allocates compute across heterogeneous organs via same budget.

title: Controlled concurrent task competition
why_ahead: NARS continuously allocates finite processor time among concurrent tasks according to dynamic priority.
aura_comparison: Aura async loops are largely operationally scheduled.
build: Create cognitive scheduler based on expected instrumental/epistemic value per compute.
proof: Adaptive allocation beats static frequencies at equal compute.

title: Best-so-far but still revisable answers
why_ahead: NARS can emit a current best answer and continue low-priority search.
aura_comparison: Aura often treats response emission as task termination.
build: Represent residual uncertainty and allow durable tasks to continue at reduced budget.
proof: Later evidence can improve/correct earlier outputs with revision lineage.

title: Temporal logic integrated with inference
why_ahead: NARS processes logical and temporal information together and supports temporal induction.
aura_comparison: Aura has event/time/world-model systems but not one symbolic temporal calculus.
build: Add before/after/interval/recurrence/lag operators and evidence rules to AtomSpace/MeTTa.
proof: Learn temporal/causal rules from event history and use in unrelated planning tasks.

title: Executable operations as terms
why_ahead: NARS represents operations in the same language as goals/events.
aura_comparison: Aura has tools, skills, Doing, RLC ops and grounded MeTTa ops in separate representations.
build: Unify symbolic Operator term with executable governed binding.
proof: A learned symbolic rule can quantify over and execute an operation without translation glue.

title: Budget inheritance for derived tasks
why_ahead: NARS assigns new inference tasks budgets based on truth/complexity/premises.
aura_comparison: Aura subgoals/hypotheses often get fixed or local budgets.
build: Derive child budgets from parent value, uncertainty, complexity and information gain.
proof: Search retains high-value branches better than fixed depth under same compute.

title: Concept as storage+processing unit
why_ahead: NARS concepts aggregate beliefs, tasks, goals and links around a term.
aura_comparison: Aura concept identity is split across vector stores, AtomSpace, LLM context, procedural vocab and world models.
build: Create ConceptHandle linking all substrate-specific representations and common evidence/budget.
proof: One concept activation can retrieve its episodic, symbolic, procedural and neural correlates.

title: Unified revision math
why_ahead: NARS evidence calculus gives explicit revision behavior.
aura_comparison: Aura has PLN revision plus other confidence blends.
build: Centralize confidence fusion invariants and duplicate-evidence protection.
proof: Contradictory cross-module evidence yields predictable calibrated belief change.

title: Cognition-integrated forgetting
why_ahead: NARS storage competition uses budget values, not separate housekeeping only.
aura_comparison: Aura pruning differs by store/ecology.
build: Use expected future utility/information minus maintenance cost as common retention value.
proof: Accelerated lifetime retains critical knowledge while keeping bounded storage.

title: One compact theory of intelligence
why_ahead: NARS derives many behaviors from one theory of adaptation under insufficient knowledge/resources.
aura_comparison: Aura combines many imported theoretical families.
build: Write Aura meta-theory identifying a small set of invariants each organ implements.
proof: Every major organ maps to an invariant; redundant organs become identifiable.

title: Task persistence by value rather than clock
why_ahead: NARS tasks decay/revive according to resource competition and feedback.
aura_comparison: Aura uses many fixed timeouts/cadences in addition to values.
build: Convert non-safety timeouts to value decay/reactivation where possible.
proof: Better completion/abandonment tradeoff on mixed-duration task suite.

title: Resource-sensitive inference control
why_ahead: NARS inference rules participate in resource allocation.
aura_comparison: Aura bounds rewriters/planners but rarely learns per-rule value/cost.
build: Learn expected cost/value for MeTTa/PLN/representation operators.
proof: At fixed wall time, learned inference ordering solves more held-out tasks.

title: Canonical implicit/explicit dual knowledge
why_ahead: CLARION explicitly separates implicit neural-like knowledge and explicit rule-level knowledge.
aura_comparison: Aura has RLC/latent/transformer and AtomSpace/MeTTa/rules but no common alignment object.
build: Create DualKnowledge linking latent encoding, explicit rule, confidence, conversion loss and provenance.
proof: Knowledge can translate both ways with measured fidelity and reuse.

title: Bottom-up rule extraction
why_ahead: CLARION emphasizes extracting explicit rules from implicit competence.
aura_comparison: Aura lacks general extraction from arbitrary learned neural/world policies.
build: Train symbolic/program extractors over RLC/world-model trajectories and falsify outputs.
proof: Extracted rules predict implicit behavior and transfer to new tasks.

title: Top-down assimilation
why_ahead: Explicit knowledge can shape/teach implicit processing in CLARION.
aura_comparison: Aura explicit procedures do not systematically distill into neural/RLC shortcuts.
build: Distill validated rules/procedures into learned substrate while preserving explicit fallback.
proof: Latency drops after distillation without behavior/equivalence regressions.

title: Action-centered dual system
why_ahead: CLARION unifies explicit and implicit action knowledge.
aura_comparison: Aura action proposals come from habits, planner, LLM, rules, world model and skills with separate semantics.
build: Build ActionPolicyHub that integrates proposal sources before governance.
proof: Ablations quantify each source and all learned action competence accumulates through one interface.

title: Declarative/non-action knowledge dual system
why_ahead: CLARION also links implicit and explicit non-action knowledge.
aura_comparison: Aura declarative knowledge is fragmented across stores and latents.
build: Link ConceptHandles to neural/explicit representations.
proof: New declarative abstractions transfer into action and prediction without bespoke adapters.

title: Unified motivation-cognition loop
why_ahead: CLARION explicitly integrates motivation with cognitive control.
aura_comparison: Aura has richer welfare/affect/drives but less compact learned theory.
build: Learn drive-to-goal/outcome sensitivities instead of hand-weighting all relationships.
proof: Drive lesions selectively alter goal generation and improve adaptation vs fixed drive weights.

title: Metacognitive control validation
why_ahead: CLARION treats metacognition as an explicit control layer studied behaviorally.
aura_comparison: Aura has stronger mechanism breadth but limited external behavioral validation.
build: Test strategy switching, confidence calibration, compute allocation and self-monitoring with matched meta/no-meta arms.
proof: Meta control produces held-out capability gains at equal compute.

title: Unified cross-level learning cycle
why_ahead: CLARION has explicit flows among implicit learning, rule extraction and assimilation.
aura_comparison: Aura learners can remain siloed.
build: Define experience -> implicit update -> explicit extraction -> falsification -> procedural/neural distillation.
proof: Three unrelated domains complete the cycle with no new learning code.

title: Implicit/explicit dissociation experiments
why_ahead: CLARION models cases where implicit competence and explicit access diverge.
aura_comparison: Aura has no dedicated dissociation battery.
build: Test performance-without-report and report-without-performance under targeted lesions.
proof: Selective dissociations are reproducible and mechanistically explained.

title: Automaticity transition
why_ahead: CLARION models movement from explicit deliberation to implicit skill.
aura_comparison: Aura has habits/chunks/RLC but no architecture-wide automaticity metric.
build: Track cortex/planner reliance versus learned fast procedures.
proof: Practice decreases deliberation while novelty restores it.

title: Cross-level contradiction handling
why_ahead: Dual systems need explicit handling of conflict between implicit and explicit knowledge.
aura_comparison: Aura can hide such conflict inside final scoring.
build: Make substrate disagreement a named impasse that can trigger experiment/arbitration.
proof: Conflicting predictions are surfaced and evidence-seeking resolves them.

title: Theory-driven subsystem boundaries
why_ahead: CLARION subsystem boundaries are derived from a coherent theory.
aura_comparison: Aura file/organ boundaries partly reflect development history.
build: Refactor around computational invariants and shared contracts.
proof: Dependency complexity falls without losing capability.

title: Human motivation/decision validation
why_ahead: CLARION aims to model human learning, decision, motivation and metacognition.
aura_comparison: Aura uses psychologically inspired mechanisms with limited human-data fitting.
build: Replicate selected CLARION paradigms.
proof: Aura predicts qualitative/quantitative human patterns beyond heuristic baseline.

title: Rule refinement lifecycle
why_ahead: CLARION explicit rules can be refined as learning continues.
aura_comparison: Aura rules can demote/prune but specialization/generalization lifecycle is not universal.
build: Add rule split/merge/specialization driven by counterexamples and transfer.
proof: Coverage/precision improve without runaway rule count.

title: Canonical cognitive cycle
why_ahead: LIDA repeatedly runs perception -> situational model -> attention/global broadcast -> procedure/action -> execution.
aura_comparison: Aura has several overlapping loops with different clocks.
build: Wrap major organs in an Aura CognitiveCycle envelope while preserving asynchronous internals.
proof: Every consequential action traces to one cycle snapshot and its learning updates.

title: Broadcast-triggered learning
why_ahead: LIDA uses each global broadcast to drive multiple continual learning processes.
aura_comparison: Aura workspace winners influence cognition but many learners update from separate events.
build: Emit LearningBroadcast with content, context, valence, prediction error, ownership and provenance.
proof: Lesions show broadcast contributes to episodic, procedural, perceptual and attentional learning.

title: Attentional learning
why_ahead: LIDA treats learning what to attend to as an ongoing mode.
aura_comparison: Aura salience has hand-tuned components despite ECAN/workspace dynamics.
build: Learn attentional policy from downstream value/information gain.
proof: Learned attention improves unseen-task sample efficiency vs static weights.

title: Perceptual associative ontology growth
why_ahead: LIDA learns objects/categories/relations into perceptual associative memory.
aura_comparison: Aura perception-to-durable-concept conversion is still narrow.
build: Create percept cluster/entity -> ConceptHandle -> AtomSpace pipeline with validation.
proof: Categories recur across scenes and support planning without relabeling by cortex.

title: Current situational model
why_ahead: LIDA combines percepts with retrieved associations before attention competition.
aura_comparison: AuraNow/world state/workspace do not yet form one universally consumed situation graph.
build: Create immutable SituationSnapshot containing percepts, inferred entities, goals, memories, self-state, affordances and uncertainty.
proof: All major decision organs consume same snapshot hash.

title: Memory transformation pipeline
why_ahead: LIDA separates transient episodic, declarative and other memory stages.
aura_comparison: Aura has rich memory but heterogeneous consolidation paths.
build: Specify sensory trace -> transient episode -> consolidated episode -> semantic abstraction -> procedure lineage.
proof: Every durable abstraction traces back to source episodes.

title: Common procedural scheme format
why_ahead: LIDA stores context/action/result procedural templates.
aura_comparison: Aura has skills/chunks/Doing/habits/operators in multiple formats.
build: Unify SituationPattern -> Operator -> PredictedEffect schema.
proof: Different learners produce procedures that compete under one representation.

title: Low-level sensory-motor memory
why_ahead: LIDA separates action selection from motor-plan execution/learning.
aura_comparison: Aura host automation is mostly discrete click/key control.
build: Add trainable low-level visual/motor controllers for trajectories/timing.
proof: Repeated motor tasks improve precision without high-level replanning.

title: Affect as learned facilitator
why_ahead: LIDA explicitly ties artificial feelings to attention, motivation and learning.
aura_comparison: Aura is richer structurally but capability gain from affect is not broadly demonstrated.
build: Run long-horizon matched affect lesions and learn mappings where possible.
proof: Affect improves exploration/recovery/resource allocation without paralysis.

title: Simultaneous online learning modes
why_ahead: LIDA expects one important event to update multiple memory/learning systems.
aura_comparison: Aura experiences often update only specific learners.
build: Create consolidation coordinator choosing all applicable learners with shared evidence ID.
proof: One novel event updates multiple learning modes coherently.

title: Theory-specific neuroscience mapping
why_ahead: LIDA literature maps cognitive-cycle mechanisms to neuroscience.
aura_comparison: Aura mixes several theoretical traditions and analogical biological labels.
build: Build NeuroCognitive Mapping Matrix with evidence grade/falsifier per mapping.
proof: Biological claims become auditable and discriminating experiments are possible.

title: Discriminating consciousness-theory tests
why_ahead: LIDA has a relatively singular GWT-based functional theory.
aura_comparison: Aura includes GWT, IIT-inspired measures, active inference, recurrent/self theories simultaneously.
build: Design experiments where theories make different predictions instead of additive green checks.
proof: At least one result favors one mechanism and falsifies another implementation.

title: Systematic developmental curriculum
why_ahead: LIDA explicitly assumes a developmental learning period.
aura_comparison: Aura development is real but concentrated in bounded recent tasks.
build: Create staged curriculum spanning perception, causality, social learning, skill, metacognition and representation.
proof: Older Aura outperforms reset Aura on later stages because of prior acquired structures.

title: Cycle timing metrics
why_ahead: LIDA provides a natural repeated unit for temporal cognition analysis.
aura_comparison: Aura organs run at different frequencies without one phase timing account.
build: Instrument cycle-phase latency/backpressure and fast vs slow loops.
proof: Performance bottlenecks localize to phases and adaptive scheduling improves throughput.

title: Neurally executable cognitive primitives
why_ahead: SPA/NEF requires cognitive operations to compile into dynamics over neuron populations rather than exist only as Python/symbolic functions.
aura_comparison: Aura has neural mesh, liquid substrate, RLC and transformer activations, but many cognitive primitives remain ordinary code with no neural realization.
build: Define a NeuralExecutable interface and compile a selected core of memory binding, action selection, transformation and working-memory operations into a shared latent substrate.
proof: For each migrated primitive, lesioning the neural implementation removes the behavior while the symbolic implementation is absent; neural dynamics reproduce the same functional result within bounded error.

title: Semantic pointer representation algebra
why_ahead: SPA uses one compositional high-dimensional vector algebra for binding, superposition, cleanup and transformation.
aura_comparison: Aura uses several unrelated vector spaces: transformer residuals, self vectors, world-model latents, RLC state, neural mesh states and embeddings.
build: Create a CanonicalCognitiveVector schema with typed projections and invertibility/uncertainty metadata; implement binding/unbinding and structured transforms.
proof: A learned concept can move among perception, working memory, planning and action without hand-written per-pair adapters and survive round-trip reconstruction tests.

title: Binding and role-filler manipulation in one substrate
why_ahead: SPA can encode structured symbolic relations through vector binding while remaining neurally executable.
aura_comparison: Aura has symbolic AtomSpace relations and vector embeddings but no universal neurally manipulable role-filler representation.
build: Add typed vector-symbol binding compatible with ConceptHandles/AtomSpace and RLC.
proof: Novel role-filler combinations are manipulated correctly without retraining each combination.

title: Basal-ganglia-style action selection as neural computation
why_ahead: Spaun implements action selection/control through a neurally realized basal-ganglia/thalamus mechanism.
aura_comparison: Aura Global Workspace and policy systems are causal but mainly coded controllers rather than population dynamics.
build: Implement an optional neural action-selection controller driven by common utility/evidence signals and compare to coded arbitration.
proof: Neural controller reproduces selection, switching and inhibition signatures and yields predictable lesion deficits.

title: Neural working memory with measurable dynamics
why_ahead: SPA working memory is realized by recurrent neural dynamics and can be analyzed for capacity, noise and decay.
aura_comparison: Aura has multiple explicit memories and continuous fields but no canonical neurally realized working-memory store.
build: Create a small recurrent semantic-pointer working-memory layer with gated write/maintain/read and interference.
proof: Capacity/decay/interference curves are measured, stable and causally linked to planning performance.

title: Perception-to-cognition vector continuity
why_ahead: Spaun maps visual input through neural processing into the same representational regime used by cognition.
aura_comparison: Aura screen perception often becomes text/layout or task-specific structures before cognition.
build: Train a visual encoder whose outputs project directly into canonical cognitive vectors and world-state entities.
proof: Novel visual stimuli can drive memory retrieval/action selection without OCR/text mediation.

title: Cognition-to-motor neural continuity
why_ahead: Spaun converts cognitive state into neurally generated motor trajectories.
aura_comparison: Aura mostly emits discrete desktop actions and relies on host automation.
build: Add learned motor primitive decoders for cursor/gesture/trajectory control under the same representation regime.
proof: Motor precision improves with practice and can execute continuous trajectories without LLM planning each step.

title: One fixed neural model across heterogeneous tasks
why_ahead: Spaun famously demonstrates multiple tasks in a single fixed neural architecture rather than loading a different cognitive program for each task.
aura_comparison: Aura has one process but frequently invokes task-specific code paths, policies and adapters.
build: Create a fixed-core cross-task battery in which no architecture code or task-specific learner changes between tasks.
proof: The same frozen cognitive/neural core performs a diverse task suite with only task observations/instructions changing.

title: Neural representational similarity diagnostics
why_ahead: Nengo/SPA gives direct access to decoded vector content and neural population activity.
aura_comparison: Aura has telemetry but no unified representational geometry analysis across organs.
build: Add CKA/RSA/subspace-angle/probe analyses across canonical latent spaces with provenance.
proof: Representational transformations are quantitatively tracked and lesions reveal where task information is gained/lost.

title: Noise-robust cleanup memory
why_ahead: Semantic pointers rely on cleanup/associative memory that retrieves structured concepts from noisy vectors.
aura_comparison: Aura has vector retrieval stores, but not a canonical cleanup operation shared by all cognitive vectors.
build: Build shared cleanup memory with confidence and collision diagnostics.
proof: Noisy/interfered bound representations recover correct concept above baselines across modalities.

title: Explicit capacity/noise tradeoff theory
why_ahead: SPA exposes how dimensionality, neuron count and noise constrain representational capacity.
aura_comparison: Aura dimensional choices are often engineering defaults rather than theory-backed capacity choices.
build: Measure capacity as a function of dimension/noise for each canonical vector channel and select from empirical tradeoffs.
proof: Configured dimensions meet declared error/capacity targets with confidence bounds.

title: Neural dynamical timing predictions
why_ahead: Nengo models evolve in continuous time with biologically motivated synaptic/neuronal dynamics.
aura_comparison: Aura continuous substrates have synthetic dynamics but little behavioral timing validation.
build: Tie selected recurrent time constants to observable cognitive transitions and fit/validate them.
proof: Perturbing time constants changes response/working-memory timing as predicted on held-out tasks.

title: Neural lesion methodology at population/connection level
why_ahead: Nengo models support targeted removal of pathways/populations with interpretable effects.
aura_comparison: Aura has a strong LesionController but lesions are often subsystem-scale.
build: Extend causal campaign to projections/populations/latent channels and compare distributed compensation.
proof: Fine-grained lesions produce reproducible selective deficits and quantify redundancy.

title: Compilation from high-level cognitive model to neural implementation
why_ahead: NEF provides a principled translation from represented functions/dynamics into neural connections.
aura_comparison: Aura lacks a general compiler from symbolic/cognitive operation to endogenous neural tissue.
build: Research a bounded Aura Neural Compiler: specify typed function plus error tolerance, synthesize/test RLC/mesh implementation, retain only validated implementations.
proof: Previously coded operations are automatically compiled into neural substrate and pass semantic equivalence plus performance tests.

title: Single neural substrate scientific coherence
why_ahead: SPA offers one mathematical representational/dynamical framework for much of cognition.
aura_comparison: Aura neural elements arise from several different inspirations and coordinate via adapters.
build: Choose a canonical neural-state algebra and require new neural organs to justify deviations.

title: Full self-hosting meta-language

title: Explicit program/knowledge introspection

title: Whole-brain reference architecture

title: Literature-to-architecture evidence pipeline

title: Cross-species homology mapping
why_ahead: WBAI ROSETTA-style work handles uncertain correspondence of brain regions across species.

title: Brain-region ontology interoperability

title: Canonical component diagrams from neuroscience

title: Biological scale accounting

title: Cell-type/circuit heterogeneity

title: Anatomical constraint on architecture search

title: Reference architecture versioning

title: Embodied competence scaling law

proof: Regression detection catches distribution shifts before subjective review.

title: Universal cognitive state contract
why_ahead: Mature architectures obtain leverage from a small number of canonical interfaces; Aura still has many organ-specific state representations.
aura_comparison: AuraNow, workspace candidates, AtomSpace atoms, world states, memory records, RLC states and planner nodes overlap without one typed envelope.
build: Define CognitiveStateRef with identity, time, provenance, uncertainty, ownership, representation links and causal parents.
proof: At least 80% of cross-subsystem cognitive handoffs use the contract and duplicate adapters are removed.

title: Universal evidence object
why_ahead: NARS/PLN-style systems force evidence semantics to be explicit, while Aura mixes confidence floats, counts, Wilson bounds, model probabilities and receipts.
aura_comparison: No architecture-wide rule prevents double-counting correlated evidence.
build: Create EvidencePacket with source IDs, dependence set, observation/derivation type, mass, likelihood or bounded confidence, and merge rules.
proof: Synthetic duplicate-evidence tests cannot inflate belief; independent evidence increases confidence predictably.

title: Universal procedural representation
why_ahead: ACT-R, Soar, CLARION and LIDA each gain from procedures being one first-class cognitive currency.
aura_comparison: Aura procedures exist as chunks, generalized rules, skills, Doing ASTs, habits, planners, RLC programs and tool schemas.
build: Create Procedure object with typed preconditions, action/program, effects, cost, risk, evidence, provenance and executable backends.
proof: Procedures learned by different subsystems can be matched, composed, valued and executed through one registry.

title: Universal concept identity across representations
why_ahead: SPA and OpenCog emphasize representations that can move across mechanisms without losing identity.
aura_comparison: Aura can represent the same concept in text, embedding, AtomSpace, world-model latent and RLC state without a stable cross-representation identity.
build: Introduce ConceptHandle plus projection registry and confidence-preserving conversions.
proof: The same learned concept is traceable across at least four substrates and can be used by each without manual relabeling.

title: Architecture-wide automatic proceduralization
why_ahead: ACT-R/Soar/CLARION make repeated deliberation naturally become compiled skill.
aura_comparison: Aura has several local compilation/learning mechanisms but no universal trace-to-skill path.
build: Observe successful causal traces, infer minimal dependencies, generalize, validate, price and compile to fastest qualified backend.
proof: Repeated heterogeneous tasks show decreasing deliberation cost due to automatically acquired procedures.

title: Architecture-wide impasse semantics
why_ahead: Soar turns failure-to-decide into a universal occasion for deeper cognition.
aura_comparison: Aura impasse.py exists but not every planner, workspace, tool chooser and representation learner reports through it.
build: Route tie/conflict/rejection/no-change/constraint failures from all decision systems to one impasse bus.
proof: Injected impasses in major organs trigger comparable subproblem handling and learning rather than silent fallback.

title: Automatic causal backtrace of successful cognition
why_ahead: Soar EBC identifies which prior conditions actually supported a result.
aura_comparison: Aura procedural_generalization uses episode features/lesions, but support dependencies are not automatically traced through arbitrary cognitive operations.
build: Record read-dependencies and causal parents for cognitive events; compute minimal support subgraph for successful resolutions.
proof: Compiled rule omits irrelevant context while retaining all necessary causal conditions across held-out variants.

title: Explicit computational cost currency
why_ahead: NARS and ACT-R-like approaches make resource use part of cognitive selection.
aura_comparison: Aura has wall-clock/resource budgets, token budgets, chunk EV and various local costs but no common cognitive cost unit.
build: Define normalized CognitiveCost from time, energy/memory pressure, model tier, tool risk and opportunity cost.
proof: Different reasoning methods can be compared under a stable Pareto frontier and learned stopping policy.

title: Value-of-computation controller
why_ahead: Resource-rational systems decide whether thinking longer is worth it.
aura_comparison: Aura has deadlines and progress-aware extension but limited learned expected-value-of-compute estimation.
build: Train meta-controller predicting marginal success gain from retrieval/search/deep-model/tool/experiment.
proof: At matched compute it allocates more work to consequential uncertain tasks and less to easy ones while improving total reward.

title: Common uncertainty calibration layer
why_ahead: Competitor traditions validate probabilities/confidence against outcomes.
aura_comparison: Aura uncertainty signals come from logits, world model, rules, self-report, beliefs and heuristics with different scales.
build: Calibrate each signal into common forecast probabilities plus reliability metadata.
proof: Reliability diagrams/Brier scores remain calibrated across domains and aggregation improves decisions.

title: Evidence-seeking action across all planners
why_ahead: Active learning should be a universal option when uncertainty matters, not confined to one pursuit path.
aura_comparison: Aura recently added epistemic action in screen pursuit but not architecture-wide.
build: Expose expected information gain as an action-value term to System 2, tool choice, social inquiry and self-testing.
proof: Across three unrelated domains, information-seeking actions reduce model uncertainty and improve later reward vs no-EIG control.

title: Learned attention across workspace, graph and perception

aura_comparison: Aura has workspace salience, ECAN-like attention and perception prioritization but they are separate.
build: Create AttentionPolicy consuming downstream causal value and allocating compute across percepts, memories, atoms and cognitive candidates.
proof: One learned policy improves held-out performance at fixed compute and shows interpretable allocation shifts.

title: Cross-domain structural analogy engine
why_ahead: CogPrime-like schematic thinking and broad transfer require recognizing shared relations despite surface difference.
aura_comparison: Aura same-kind transfer is currently coarse and representation transfer remains narrow.

proof: A strategy learned in domain A improves domain B with different surface vocabulary and geometry; shuffled structural mapping does not.

title: Implicit-explicit-neural tri-directional conversion

aura_comparison: Aura has all three forms but no universal conversion cycle.

proof: A skill travels through all three forms and preserves behavior within tolerance; each form adds measurable benefit.

title: Developmental compounding benchmark

aura_comparison: Aura has narrow keep-vs-forget wins but no long, unrelated-task campaign.

proof: The performance/sample-efficiency gap grows with experience and survives matched memory/context/compute controls.

title: Age-of-agent capability curve
why_ahead: Development should produce a measurable relationship between experience history and competence.
aura_comparison: Aura has no canonical maturity curve.

title: Unrelated-domain transfer criterion
why_ahead: Strong generality requires transfer beyond superficially similar task signatures.
aura_comparison: Current transfer mechanisms often depend on shared shape/action vocabulary.

proof: At least one learned abstraction reaches the structural-analogue/unrelated-domain tier with causal benefit.

aura_comparison: Aura representation growth mainly adds vocabulary/constructors, not arbitrary evaluator extensions.

proof: New operator survives adversarial/held-out tests and rollback restores exact prior semantics.

aura_comparison: Aura has strong causal influence tools but architecture-wide matched-compute organ accounting remains incomplete.

proof: Each retained organ has a capability contribution report or is classified as exploratory/non-load-bearing.

title: Architecture compression / minimum sufficient mind

aura_comparison: Aura risks duplicated mechanisms and interaction complexity.

proof: Core subsystem count/dependency entropy falls while benchmark and developmental performance stay constant or improve.

title: Parameter uncertainty and identifiability
why_ahead: Cognitive modeling requires knowing whether fitted parameters are actually determined by data.
aura_comparison: Aura increasingly records parameter provenance but many hand-selected thresholds have no posterior/sensitivity analysis.

proof: Claims no longer depend on unidentifiable point estimates and sensitivity reports are generated automatically.

title: Frozen preregistered evaluation

aura_comparison: Aura often develops and evaluates in the same rapidly changing repo.

aura_comparison: Aura key results are still primarily self-produced.

aura_comparison: Aura uses a pretrained cortex and large local knowledge stores, complicating novelty claims.

proof: Developmental gains survive tasks highly unlikely to be memorized and matched base-model controls.

title: Environment-level causal receipt

aura_comparison: Aura recently improved this in screen pursuit, but not all environment actions share one transition receipt.

aura_comparison: Aura has lattice/page/window protections in pursuit but no universal object identity layer.

proof: World model and memory refer to the same entity across motion/occlusion/view changes.

title: Multi-timescale world model

aura_comparison: Aura has several clocks and memory horizons but no one hierarchical dynamics model.

proof: Planner can choose appropriate temporal level and long-horizon predictions outperform flat rollout.

title: Counterfactual causal model learning
why_ahead: Strong world understanding requires interventions, not only next-state prediction.
aura_comparison: Aura has causal experiments/epistemic actions but world-model VRNN is primarily predictive.

proof: Recovered causal graph predicts unseen interventions better than correlational model.

title: Skill compositionality across backends
why_ahead: ACT-R/Soar/SPA/Hyperon all benefit when learned components can be reused compositionally.
aura_comparison: Aura has action composition and RLC composition, but skills from different backends do not share one composition algebra.

proof: Novel multi-step skills are assembled from previously learned components across at least two backends.

title: Lifetime skill ecology

aura_comparison: Aura has word ecology and chunk EV locally, but no universal lifetime skill economy.

proof: System retains high-value skills, retires harmful ones, and decision latency remains bounded as experience grows.

title: Catastrophic interference measurement across all learners
why_ahead: Continual learning needs explicit forgetting metrics, not just persistence.
aura_comparison: Aura has replay and protected promotion mechanisms but no universal backward-transfer dashboard.

proof: Developmental gains occur with bounded negative backward transfer; rollback catches damaging updates.

aura_comparison: Aura has dream/consolidation ideas but learners consolidate differently.

title: Social world-model learning from interaction
why_ahead: Humanlike general intelligence requires learned models of other agents over time, not only pretrained social text knowledge.
aura_comparison: Aura has linguistic social ability and bounded other-agent mechanisms but little lived social model evidence.

proof: Repeated interaction predicts partner actions/preferences better than language-model prior alone and transfers across contexts.

title: Theory-of-mind uncertainty separation

aura_comparison: Aura self/world structures do not yet provide a universal nested epistemic-state calculus.

proof: False-belief/partial-observability tasks are solved via explicit perspective state; lesions selectively break them.

title: Capability-neutral consciousness experiments

aura_comparison: Aura has many functional/consciousness probes but base-model competence can confound some behavioral outputs.

proof: Claimed signatures persist as mechanism-specific effects after controlling language output quality.

title: Competing-theory model selection

aura_comparison: Aura includes GWT-, IIT-, active-inference-, HOT-like and other constructs.

proof: Some theories/mechanisms lose support and are simplified/removed when predictions fail.

title: Biology/engineering label separation

aura_comparison: Aura has many evocative biological/consciousness labels.

proof: System card can automatically separate implemented computation from biological/phenomenal interpretation.

title: Cognitive architecture invariant tests
why_ahead: Highly integrated minds need tests for architectural invariants beyond unit behavior.
aura_comparison: Aura has many tests but the number of interacting organs makes hidden bypasses possible.

proof: Fault injection mid-update leaves all involved cognitive stores at a coherent prior or committed state.

title: Research-grade experiment registry

aura_comparison: Aura has artifacts/claims matrices but no universal experiment schema for all cognition claims.
build: Create ExperimentRegistry with hypothesis, commit/model/data hashes, treatment/nulls, preregistration, metrics, result and claim boundary.
proof: Every quantitative claim in system card links to a machine-readable experiment record.

title: Compute-matched ablation discipline
